Russia Adds Telegram Founder Pavel Durov to Wanted List

Russia has placed Telegram founder Pavel Durov on its international wanted list. The financial watchdog Rosfinmonitoring added Durov to a list of "extremists and terrorists." This action is reportedly linked to terrorism charges.
